model.name: Task 30.4: Lobby shows the real profile name (not random User NNN)
model.description: Fix the lobby profile-name regression in RoomBrowser: the lobby shows a random "User NNN" instead of the real profile name (Marcel Donges) because RoomBrowser.ts:29 syncs memberName BEFORE the async profile load resolves -> re-randomizes every reload. Use the profile name once LOADED (async), fall back to a random name only as a true last resort. The room token (05e58f81) stays stable; only the display name regresses.
model.intention: Tron regression (S30 reopened): lobby must show the real profile name, stably across reloads.

model.acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] (name) The lobby 'Your Name' shows the PROFILE name (Marcel Donges), NOT a random 'User NNN'.
- [ ] (bug) THE BUG: RoomBrowser.ts:29 computes memberName SYNC before the profile loads (async race) -> profile?.name null -> random fallback -> a different name every reload.
- [ ] (fix) Fix = use the profile name once LOADED (await profile / re-render on profile-load); random 'User NNN' only as a TRUE last resort (no profile at all).
- [ ] (identity) The profile token/uuid is stable (05e58f81) - only the displayed NAME regresses; the fix must not change the stable identity token, only the name resolution.
